$comment: Sujeto y zona limpia de pedidos aprobados del Portal; la reproducción exacta (assemble) se comprueba contra el prompt del propio pedido. La 15 de Developer es obsoleta (ver 'obsolete').

cases.subject: A paper boat leaving a quay, its wake drawn as three thin lines, ink grey on off-white.

A lighthouse under construction on a small rocky islet in the open sea, seen from slightly above, its round stone tower only half built and wrapped in fine wooden scaffolding with ladders and a small wooden crane, drawn in crisp off-white and ink grey line art with fine engraved shading, small ripples around the rocks.
cases.cleanZone: the lighthouse small on the left third, open water on the right

cases.subject: A small rocky islet in the open sea, seen from slightly above, where a lighthouse is about to be built: only a low round stone foundation ring has been laid, with wooden survey stakes and taut ropes marking out the circle of the future tower, a few cut stone blocks stacked beside it and a small wooden surveyor's tripod, drawn in crisp off-white and ink grey line art with fine engraved shading, small ripples around the rocks.
cases.cleanZone: the islet small on the left third, open water on the right

cases.subject: A finished lighthouse standing on a small rocky islet in the open sea at night, seen from slightly above, the night sky in deep dark cerulean and ink grey built from dense fine hatching with a few tiny off-white stars, the sea a deep dark cerulean, its lantern lit with a soft off-white light casting two long beams drawn as fine off-white radiating lines across the dark water, a small seaweed green #5d7a6a door at its base, drawn in crisp off-white and ink grey line art with fine engraved shading, small ripples around the rocks catching the light.
cases.cleanZone: the lighthouse small on the left third, open water on the right

obsolete.subject: A flat graphic seen straight on: a line of small round buoys connected by a single white line, running from left to right across the upper two thirds and stepping up and down like a sequence of steps in a process, white line on medium cerulean blue.
obsolete.cleanZone: The lower third left clean, flat and empty
differences: Obsoleto: el pedido es anterior a la decisión del 2026-11-11 (la 15 de Developer es el barco de papel, q311, cuyo prompt no está en el repositorio): lleva boyas y «white», que la hoja veta. No se reproduce; solo sirve para comprobar que la hoja lo veta.
